ROV Pilot Technician: Demonstrate general safety awareness and ensure compliance with Northwind Offshore HSEQ requirements
Ensure that all control measures identified by TRAs are in place prior to task commencing.
Participate in toolbox talks in accordance with Northwind Offshore requirements
Demonstrate the ability to effectively communicate with the operational team
Perform monthly (30 day) planned maintenance activities
Assist with installation and repair activities on electrical / electronic systems
Assist with installation and repair activities on mechanical / hydraulic systems
Act as ROV pilot for routine tasks in relatively placid environmental conditions
Operate launch and recovery equipment under supervision
ROV Submersible Technician: Demonstrate general safety awareness and ensure compliance with Northwind Offshore HSEQ requirements
Ensure that all control measures identified by TRAs are in place prior to task commencing.
Participate in toolbox talks in accordance with Northwind Offshore requirements
Demonstrate the ability to effectively communicate with the operational team
Find faults and make repairs to electronic/electrical equipment
Find faults and make repairs to mechanical/hydraulic equipment
Interface ancilliary equipment onto the ROV and into the Control Van
Act as Deck Supervisor during launch and recovery in placid environmental conditions
Act as ROV pilot in adverse environmental conditions or during difficult tasks
Take control of shift during supervisor’s absence
ROV Supervisor: Demonstrate general safety awareness and ensure compliance with Northwind Offshore HSEQ requirements
Lead by example and coach other personnel in general safety awareness, ensuring risk measures are enforced
Lead TRAs and toolbox talks in accordance with Northwind Offshore requirements
Demonstrate the ability to effectively communicate with the operational team
Demonstrate the ability to effectively communicate with the client, marine crew, and company management
Demonstrate effective supervision and leadership skills
Demonstrate the ability to provide ongoing assessment and coaching for personnel
Demonstrate understanding of project performance requirements and familiarity with project documentation relating to ROV operations
Demonstrate a thorough understanding of Project & ROV Dive Planning
Manage all ROV specific project equipment and spares to ensure they are in a satisfactory condition and being maintained as such to ensure efficient operations
Manage and review the amount of spares held for the forthcoming operations taking into account region of operation, duration of project
Provide detailed end of trip reports to relevant onshore departments
